results.title: Explainer: UKRI’s support for international research and innovation – UKRI
results.content: # Explainer: UKRI’s support for international research and innovation. An overview of how UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) brings global knowledge to the UK and UK expertise to the world. The UK is playing a leading role by ensuring its expertise and infrastructures can collaborate with the best researchers, innovators, and institutions around the world. Research and innovation is inherently a global endeavour, and becoming more so: around 60% of UK publications now include an international co-author (see International comparison of the UK research base, 2022 from GOV.uk). It has been shown to increase the citation impact of UK publications, the quality of the research we produce and the societal impacts we are able to achieve, by supporting local solutions for local problems. International research and innovation collaboration has also been shown to enhance the economic impact of the UK’s research and innovation (see Economic Benefits of International Collaboration in Research, Development and Innovation from the Innovation and Research Caucus).
